answer: Clone crews cannot share one cairn. An applicant locks 10.25 POA and draws one hollow quartz plumb at a reserved geodetic vertex for 10 minutes. They lower the 0.91 kg plumb 2.4 m down the shaft and cut a 15-bit wind-notch of vertex-id, pubkey, and epoch seed into the collar in seconds 12-38. Two ridge clocks accept only a 3.10-3.35 s drop. 75 aliases would freeze 768.75 POA and need 75 exclusive shafts. Auditors re-time the drop and replay the vertex draw from the seed. A reused shaft, notch clash, or drop off by more than 0.12 s burns 48% and seals that ridge for six epochs.
